title: The corner's row of the block inverse: exact rows, a frozen rule, a held-out test
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-11, before any exact row is computed. At n = 2^m, K_n is the block operator of RETURN-LAW-20261110-001C (Theorem 7) on V_L + V_R, the n - 1 rows of the first and last columns of the v-grid. Its corner row e_(L,0) K_n^-1 has 2(n - 1) entries rho_(X,b)(s) in GF(2)(s), X in {L, R}, b = 0, ..., n - 2: rho_(L,b)(w^2) is the series of the walks from c = (0, 1) to the v contact (0, 2b + 1) and rho_(R,b)(w^2) to (N, 2b + 1), N = 2n - 2 (the decomposition counts exactly the walks that end on an end column). Known: rho_(L,0) = 1/(1 + L(s^2)) at 4 to 512 (C1, exact) and rho_(R,n-2) = s^(2n-1)/(1 + L(s^2)) (the far corner, computed to 128). Target: one uniform rule for every entry at every power of two, found on the training sides 4, 8, 16, 32 and tested on the held-out side 64, with the closed form, the partial rule and no pattern defined in proof.md and frozen here. Found before registration (exploration in RETURN-LAW-20261110-001, truncated series to s^64 at 4, 8, 16): the row does not pair the way the quadrant's does (entry 2k = t0 entry 2k - 1); its first two right-block entries equal its last two left-block entries. Nothing exact.
failure_conditions: The exact rows cannot be computed by the frozen method (Berlekamp-Massey does not stabilise within the bound).
A rule committed before side 64 fails at side 64 (the verdict is then no pattern, or a partial rule).
remaining_obligations: a rule committed before side 64, or the record that none was found
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38), and its walk over GF(2) at the powers of two. The row is a contact-level reading (A45).
